admin_principals_kind_slot_check.name: admin_principals_kind_slot_check
admin_principals_kind_slot_check.value: ("admin_principals"."kind" = 'super_admin' AND "admin_principals"."singleton_slot" = 1) OR ("admin_principals"."kind" IN ('delegated_admin', 'quarantined_admin') AND "admin_principals"."singleton_slot" IS NULL)

admin_roles_origin_check.name: admin_roles_origin_check
admin_roles_origin_check.value: ("admin_roles"."system_key" IS NULL AND "admin_roles"."created_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("admin_roles"."system_key" IS NOT NULL AND "admin_roles"."created_by_user_id" IS NULL)

announcements_english_copy_check.name: announcements_english_copy_check
announcements_english_copy_check.value: ("announcements"."title_en" IS NULL AND "announcements"."body_en" IS NULL) OR ("announcements"."title_en" IS NOT NULL AND "announcements"."body_en" IS NOT NULL)

ai_conversations_scope_check.name: ai_conversations_scope_check
ai_conversations_scope_check.value: ("ai_conversations"."context_scope" = 'resume' AND "ai_conversations"."section_id" IS NULL) OR ("ai_conversations"."context_scope" = 'section' AND "ai_conversations"."section_id" IS NOT NULL)

ai_provider_credentials_owner_check.name: ai_provider_credentials_owner_check
ai_provider_credentials_owner_check.value: ("ai_provider_credentials"."kind" = 'platform' AND "ai_provider_credentials"."owner_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("ai_provider_credentials"."kind" = 'user' AND "ai_provider_credentials"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

ai_runs_execution_payload_check.name: ai_runs_execution_payload_check
ai_runs_execution_payload_check.value: ("ai_runs"."encrypted_execution_payload" IS NULL AND "ai_runs"."execution_payload_key_version" IS NULL) OR ("ai_runs"."encrypted_execution_payload" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_runs"."execution_payload_key_version" IS NOT NULL)
